messages:
Elliot James: Quick thread  trying a different rhythm for the benchmark launch: two short entry points for readers. 1) 'Prototype' path (low latency UX) 2) 'Throughput' path (economical indexing). Each gets a tiny chart + single CTA. Thoughts?
Marina Cole: love that. makes it prescriptive for buyers. can we bake in the routing story (how a customer would pick a path) in the post copy?
Devon Park: yes  add a tiny 'how it gets served' callout: hosted fastpath vs dedicated batch pool. good place to mention quantization and prefix caching.
Sofia Lin: sketching microcopy: 'Prototype: real-time replies for fast feedback' and 'Throughput: process millions of documents cost-effectively.' keep tone confident, not academic.
Elliot James: For charts, let's avoid a dense line; use two minimalist sparklines + a 3-point table. designers can mock quickly. sample CSV for the design/dev teams: ```
scenario,p50_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k,model_variant
prototype,60,140,11.2,fp16
balanced,180,800,4.8,8bit
throughput,520,3200,1.3,4bit-q
```
Marina Cole: Excellent. Also propose two CTAs in the post flow: 'Try instant demo' (self-serve) and 'Request a throughput review' (sales). seed tracking params: ?utm_source=bench&utm_path=instant or =throughput.
Devon Park: for the webinar segment: 90s demo on prototype prompt, then switch to a 10k doc batch run and show cost r.o.i. short math overlay: tokens processed per dollar. include a downloadable 1-pager with the 3-point table.
Sofia Lin: tone note: avoid 'cheapest' language; prefer 'economical at scale', 'predictable unit cost', 'SLA-backed fastpath'.
copy-bot: Suggested subject lines: 1) "Prototype or throughput: pick your performance" 2) "Latency that delights. Economics that scale."
Elliot James: timeline: Marina to draft 1 narrative-led post and 1 data-led summary by EOD, Devon to finalize CSV and small explainer for routing, Sofia to prepare CTAs + webinar micro-script. We'll review in the 4pm creative sync. Thanks! :sparkles:
